question:
Assertion (A): When a soft iron rod is inserted into an inductive coil connected to an AC source, the bulb in series with the coil glows dimmer.
Reason (R): Soft iron has high magnetic permeability, which increases the self-inductance and consequently the inductive reactance of the coil.

options.A: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
options.B: Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
options.C: A is true but R is false
options.D: A is false but R is true
